RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the July 30, 2002/Sravana 8, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Commerce and Industry; Finance and Company
Affairs; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism and Culture;
Water Resources)
Total number of questions—155

WIN2\SESSION\2299RS 297
New hand trolleys at Sardar Patel
Airport, Gujarat
†1339. DR. A.K. PATEL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to refer to answer to Unstarred Question
163 given in the Rajya Sabha on the 24th
July, 2001 and state:
(a) whether no action has so far been
taken for purchasing hand trolleys at Sardar
Patel International Airport in Gujarat; and
(b) by when the hand trolleys will be
replaced in view of their bad condition?
Security at IGI airport
†1340. SHRI HARENDRA SINGH
MALIK: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item which appeared
on 22nd June, 2002 in Rashtriya Sahara
captioned ‘‘I.G.I. se udan bharne wale
wiman aasani se atankvadion ka nishana
ban sakte hain";
(b) if so, what are the details in this regard
and Government's reaction thereto; and
(c) the action taken/proposed to be taken
to ensure security at all the airports of the
country?
IA flights on New Delhi-Jabalpur-
Gwalior route
†1341. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines have stopped
its flights IC-437 and IC-438 which were
operated on New Delhi-Jabalpur route via
Gwalior;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government propose to
introduce these flights once again; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Appointment of CMD in AI
1342. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India
continues to be without a permanent CMD
in spite of the urgent need to boost the
management of the airlines, which is
incurring losses; and
(b) if so, what are Government's plans
to appoint a CMD to this airline?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

298
WIN2\SESSION\2299RS 298
Development projects in Assam
1343. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the projects taken up
for development of Civil Aviation in
Assam during the last three years, till date;
(b) the details of the projects
completed/under progress and likely to
be completed during the above period;
(c) the total amount of funds
sanctioned/released and utili zed for each
project so far; and
(d) the effective measures being taken
by Government in this regard?
Privatisation of ground handling of
I.A., A.I. and Alliance Air
1344. SHRI BHAGATRAM
MANHAR:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering a proposal for privatisation
of ground handling operations of Indian
Airlines, Air India and Alliance Air at
various airports;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what is the estimated cost being
incurred by these Airlines on ground
handling of these airlines per month; and
(d) whether the privatisation of ground
handling of these Airlines at various
airports will improve the quality of
service, and if so, by when the proposal
to privatise ground handling system will
be finalised?
Agreement with foreign partners
1345. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Karnataka Government has
brought to the notice of the Ministry of Civil
Aviation certain provisions of the Airports
Authority of India Act, which are coming in
the way of finalizing the agreement with
foreign partners for Bangalore International
Airport; and
(b) if so, what action has been taken in
the matter?
Air services on Delhi-Raipur-Jabalpur
route
†1346. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines has
formulated any scheme to survey the area
for starting air services in future to Bilaspur,
the  important city of Chhattisgarh and
Jagdalpur, the tribal dominated area of
district Bastar;
(b) whether Indian Airlines is planning
to start regular air service from Bhopal, the
capital of Madhya Pradesh to Raipur, the
capital of Chhattisgarh; and
(c) the reasons for closing down the air
services all of a sudden from Delhi to Raipur
via Jabalpur?
Upgradation of aircrafts in I.A.
1347. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is a requirement of
upgrading the current fleet of aircrafts under
the Indian Airlines;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(b) if so, to what extent and the details
thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) when the aircrafts were upgraded
last time?
New legislation on airport security
